column1: # Divergence-visibility fixtures.  Consumed by capture.sh and check.sh.
# slice   comma-separated list of blocks cut from ONE theory load:
#           wf      the wellformedness report block (wf_gate.sh's slice)
# mode    match    the port must reproduce the captured oracle bytes
#         diverge  the port must reproduce <name>.<slice>.rs.txt, which must
#                  still differ from the captured oracle bytes.  mode is per
#                  ROW, so every slice a `diverge` row lists has to diverge on
#                  its own — a slice the two engines agree on reads as the
# flags   extra prover flags, passed to BOTH engines
